QUESTION:
What is the default value of `metrics.enabled`?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0115] config | snapshotter.enabled | version 4.x
# `snapshotter.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.enabled` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
enabled = true
```

---

# `broker.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `false` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | broker |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `broker.enabled` only if you observe problems with the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

[d0234] config | metrics.log_level | version 4.x
# `metrics.log_level`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: debug | info | warn | error |
| Default | `warn` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | metrics |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `metrics.log_level` only if you observe problems with the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
log_level = "warn"
```
